create_TransformerMetadata: create a TransformerMetadata instance with axis sizes, embedding dim, projection dim, mlp hidden dim, vocab size, and activation dtype
build_TransformerFeedForward: build a TransformerFeedForward layer as an informatively-named Sequential subclass for feedforward/MLP blocks
build_TransformerBlock: build a TransformerBlock as an informatively-named Sequential subclass for the main transformer blocks with custom treescope color
create_TransformerLM: create a TransformerLM top-level decoder wrapper that holds a body layer and metadata, then scores log-probabilities for given token inputs
run_TransformerLM_call: run a TransformerLM model by calling it with token NamedArrays and optional token_positions to produce logits over the vocabulary
